purpose: Source-bound serial C/G/F/W 50-update resource profiles using the reviewed frozen recipe after removing four unsupported options whose default semantics are algebraically identical to the immutable cached-distillation implementation. This authorizes bounded implementation/resource profiles only, not full fits or quality claims.

h384_history.note: Historical H384x2 full fit, not an age/growth-wave fit; used as a conservative reserve reference only.

scope.observed_vram_enforcement: The reviewed authority sets 5,000,000,000 bytes as the per-profile observed-VRAM ceiling. bandit_resources records observed VRAM but its GPU attempt record has observed_vram_cap_bytes=null; the operator must monitor and stop on threshold crossing. This is not a hard controller-enforced cap.
scope.trainer_allocator_policy: The worker explicitly sets WNN_GPU_MEMORY_BYTES=4300000000, which frozen src/wnn/resources.py converts to a PyTorch per-process allocator fraction. This is not a cap on CUDA context or total observed device usage.
